scope: One fixed immediate-mating-offer rule added to unchanged original learners. Saved data only; no ratings, engines, app changes or deployment.
rule: Both windows eligible, confidence sufficient; ec_sacrifice false, physical_unknown false, prior_history_missing false, attribution_unknown false, mating_acceptance true; prior same-square and original-square gains exactly zero; same_root_rank 1; best_second_gap_pp >10; wc(best_mapped_score)-wc(prior_mapped_score)>5. Required numeric values finite. Thresholds inherited from original Good classifier, not outcome tuned.

learners: custom64tree depth6 leaf8distinctmoves mtry12 cost5split rawleaf groupbootstrap
sklearnRF128tree depth6 leaf16rows mtry12 unweightedclasses rowbootstrap
evaluation.threshold_rule: Max innerOOF TP with FP<=fixedoriginal reference FP AND wrong-award fraction<=fixedoriginal reference. Same exact-score threshold selection/ties as previous study.
evaluation.selection: Max inner TP then fewer FP; ties fixed custom, retuned custom, RF, gated custom, gated RF. Always-on arms descriptive only and excluded from selection.
evaluation.control: Original features, models, seeds, folds, guards, weights and thresholds unchanged; exact baseline parity required.
evaluation.primary_reporting: Pooled outer held-out counts, gained/lost true/wrong awards; gated arms primary, always-on diagnostic. Selected procedure reported too.
evaluation.sensitivity: Report scores on outer TEST rows excluding every pilot whole group. Training folds may include pilot groups when legal. This is a non-pilot-case breakdown, not new independent validation.
evaluation.subgroup: Eligible ec=false; fresh hard; fixed-rule hits; outside48pilot groups.
evaluation.final_calibration: Same separate5fold final calibration; train/freeze one selected fullfit. No replay on already-seen654 in this experiment; leave fresh validation for later.
evaluation.addon: Gated rule enabled only when inner OOF baseline+rule adds at least one TP and ZERO FP. Baseline cutoff unchanged. Always-on diagnostic arms apply rule regardless of inner result.

interpretation: Development evidence on repeatedly used corpus. Ne5 inspired this rule but has unverified Chess.com label; excluded from training/evaluation, separately diagnosed. Similar ordinary controls are dataset negatives with same rule features. Whole-group bootstrap conditional on fixed predictions excludes repeated-study uncertainty.
stop: No outcome-dependent tuning, retries, cutoff sweeps or repeated654benchmark replay.
